newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa govt urged to cut tax burden, expenditure.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa govt urged to cut tax burden, expenditure.

text.p: The Reserve Bank on Thursday called on the government to cut the tax burden on South Africans and reduce total expenditure to ensure financial stability.
In its latest Quarterly Bulletin, the central bank praised Finance Minister Trevor Manuel for bringing down the budget deficit but said this was only part of the package needed.

"The danger of a persistent rise in the ratio of government debt to gross domestic product and the threat of such a development for overall financial stability, have apparently been put to rest," it said.
"Nonetheless, the upward trend in tax revenues and total government expenditure relative to gross domestic product is yet to be arrested."
